## Description {#details}

<p>The configuration of a test session, and its command-line parser.</p>


<p>The options are usually constructed from the command line, by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/runner/#a39ee9ec53f8df687cd84092de5118592">runner::initialise</a> (argc, argv)</span>, which creates the selected reporter and starts the session:</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">tr.initialise (argc, argv);</span></span></div>

</div>


<p>The applications that do not have a command line, such as the embedded ones without semihosting arguments, can define the options directly, starting from the defaults:</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">mt::runner_options options{};</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">options.selected_reporter = mt::reporter_kind::human;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">options.verbosity_level = mt::verbosity::verbose;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">tr.initialise (options);</span></span></div>

</div>


<p>The applications can also parse the command line themselves, and adjust the result before passing it to the runner:</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">mt::runner_options options{ argc, argv };</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">options.list_tests = </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">true</span><span class="doxyHighlight">;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">tr.initialise (options);</span></span></div>

</div>


<p>The configuration members are public, since any combination of their values is valid; only the results of the parsing (whether errors were found, and whether the reporter was unknown) are private, and are read by the runner.</p>


<p>The options own their strings (the command line, the path of the output file, and the filter patterns), so they do not depend on the lifetime of the caller's strings; the runner keeps its own copy of them.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Since</dt>
<dd><p>5.1.0</p></dd>
</dl>

### runner\_options() {#a561d969dc26eb39663173a4a6684b0d9}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::runner_options::runner_options (int argc, char * argv=[])</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>

<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel explicit">explicit</span>
</span>
</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Constructs the options by parsing the command line.</p>


<p>Starts from the defaults, and parses the µTest++ options (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">--reporter</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--silent</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--quiet</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--verbose</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--output-file</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--use-colour</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--filter</span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--list-tests</span>). The other arguments are ignored, since the applications may define their own, except for those starting with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--</span>, which are reported as unknown options.</p>


<p>A missing option argument, an unknown reporter name, an unknown colour mode, or an unknown option, is reported on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stderr</span>, the option is ignored, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a4ed347422b26dded0244c3926ef384a8">has_errors()</a></span> is set; <span class="doxyComputerOutput">run()</span> then returns</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>The errors are not written in the report, since the reporter does not exist yet.</li>
</ol>

<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput">argv[]</span> strings are copied, so they need not outlive the options.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">argc</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The argument count from main().</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">argv</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The argument vector from main().</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Since</dt>
<dd><p>5.1.0</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Scans the arguments after <span class="doxyComputerOutput">argv[0]</span>, in order, for:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">--reporter=&lt;name&gt;</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--reporter &lt;name&gt;</span>, with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">tap</span> (the default) or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">human</span>;</li>
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">--verbose</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--quiet</span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--silent</span>;</li>
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">--output-file=&lt;path&gt;</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--output-file &lt;path&gt;</span>;</li>
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color[=&lt;when&gt;]</span>, as in the GNU tools, with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">always</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">never</span>, or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">auto</span> (the default), and their GNU synonyms (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">yes</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">force</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">no</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">none</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">tty</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">if-tty</span>); <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span> alone means <span class="doxyComputerOutput">always</span>;</li>
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">--use-colour=&lt;mode&gt;</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--use-colour &lt;mode&gt;</span>, the Catch2 and Boost UT alternative to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span>, with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">yes</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">no</span>, or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">auto</span>, or any of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span> values;</li>
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">--filter=&lt;pattern&gt;</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--filter &lt;pattern&gt;</span>;</li>
<li><span class="doxyComputerOutput">--list-tests</span>, or its short form <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--list</span>, as in Catch2 and Boost UT, to list the test cases instead of running them.</li>
</ul>

<p>When an option is repeated, the last one takes effect, except <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--filter</span>, whose patterns are all kept, in order, one per nesting level; <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--use-colour</span> set the same option. An option argument given separately is the next argument, whatever its content; <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span> accepts its value only after <span class="doxyComputerOutput">=</span>. The other arguments are ignored. The whole command line is copied into <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#ae26cb575ce2e252eef06b7b124a6400a">arguments</a></span>, to be listed by the reporter; the option values are copied from there.</p>


<p>A missing option argument, an unknown reporter name, an unknown colour mode, or an unknown <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--</span> option, is recorded by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#abe865fdd65296f743fd11bdf5ef79a14">add_error()</a></span>, and the option is ignored (for an unknown reporter, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a29f60856a79601eaa48a2bb7a3a615ff">has_invalid_reporter_</a></span> is also set, to stop the session in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/runner/#a39ee9ec53f8df687cd84092de5118592">runner::initialise()</a></span>); the parsing continues with the next argument.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Whether the console output uses colours.</p>


<p>Set by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color[=&lt;when&gt;]</span>, as in the GNU tools, where <span class="doxyComputerOutput">&lt;when&gt;</span> is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">always</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">never</span>, or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">auto</span>, or one of their GNU synonyms (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">yes</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">force</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">no</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">none</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">tty</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">if-tty</span>), and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span> alone means <span class="doxyComputerOutput">always</span>; the value is accepted only after <span class="doxyComputerOutput">=</span>. The alternative <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--use-colour=&lt;mode&gt;</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--use-colour &lt;mode&gt;</span>, as in Catch2 and Boost UT, takes <span class="doxyComputerOutput">yes</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">no</span>, or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">auto</span>, and also accepts the other values of <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span>. Used only by the human reporter.</p>

### filter\_patterns {#a62b0a05ad2be4f3a5131aaf8bb523910}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">std::vector&lt;std::string&gt; micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::runner_options::filter_patterns {}</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>The patterns that select the suites and the test cases to run, one per nesting level.</p>


<p>Each <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--filter=&lt;pattern&gt;</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--filter &lt;pattern&gt;</span> option adds one pattern; unlike the other options, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--filter</span> may be repeated. As with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--grep</span> in node-tap, the first pattern applies to the suite names, the second to the names of the test cases, and each further pattern to the names of the test cases nested one level deeper; the levels without a pattern are not filtered.</p>


<p>Within a pattern, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">|</span> separates alternatives; a name matches when it matches any of them, as defined by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-cpp-api-utility-functions/#gaa2f0f4cff320a783ad2347c9ff3fc731">utility::is_match()</a></span>: <span class="doxyComputerOutput">*</span> matches any sequence of characters, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">?</span> matches any single character, the match is case-sensitive, and the alternative must cover the whole name.</p>


<p>The suites and the test cases that do not match are reported as skipped, and their bodies are not called. The top suite is never skipped as a whole, since its body is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">main()</span>, but when its name does not match the first pattern, all its test cases are skipped.</p>


<p>When the list is empty (the default), everything runs.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Since</dt>
<dd><p>5.1.0</p></dd>
</dl>

### list\_tests {#ac4f95336439b329d0f3731a5dcafb6f9}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">

</tr>
</table>
</td>

</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Whether the test cases are listed instead of run.</p>


<p>Set by the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--list-tests</span> option, or by its short form <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--list</span>. When set, the suite bodies run, as usual, to create their test cases, but the bodies of the test cases do not, so no check is evaluated. The selected test cases (see <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a62b0a05ad2be4f3a5131aaf8bb523910">filter_patterns</a></span>) are listed under the names of their suites, as Catch2 lists them:</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">All available test cases:</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">  Sample</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    Check various conditions</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    Check strings</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">  Explicit </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">namespace </span><span class="doxyHighlight">suite</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    Check one</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">3 test cases in 2 test suites</span></span></div>

</div>


<p>The header is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Matching test cases:</span> when there are filter patterns, and the suites without selected test cases are not listed. The nested test cases are not listed, since they are created by the bodies of their parents, which do not run. The list is written to the console, unless the verbosity is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">silent</span>, and to the output file, if any; no report is written, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">run()</span> returns 0, or 2 after an option error.</p>
